text:
Type: jute flatwoven rug
Use: adding natural texture by a door or bed; entryway, hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: coastal, rustic, bohemian
Materials: thick woven jute, chunky ribbed weave
Colors: warm natural tan, light straw, hints of rust
Shape: small rectangle with coarse vertical ribbed texture, plain edges, flat but chunky, compact
Feel: earthy, warm, organic, relaxed
Goes with: light wood, rattan, white walls, linen and cotton; coastal, bohemian or farmhouse rooms

product.name: LOHALS
product.description: Jute is a durable and recyclable material with natural colour variations.
